games.name: Paul McCartney at Bowery Ballroom - New York
games.description: Paul McCartney played an unannounced club show at the 575-capacity Bowery Ballroom on February 11, 2025, days before the Saturday Night Live fiftieth anniversary special. Tickets cost fifty dollars cash at the box office, one per person, and sold out within roughly half an hour. The career-spanning set opened with A Hard Day's Night and included the American live debut of Now And Then.

games.name: Deftones: North American Tour 2025 - Indianapolis
games.description: Deftones played Gainbridge Fieldhouse on March 28, 2025, one arena stop on a spring North American tour that paired the Sacramento band with The Mars Volta. Fleshwater opened the evening at seven, The Mars Volta followed just before eight, and Deftones took the stage shortly after nine. The run drew heavily on the White Pony and Diamond Eyes catalogue.

games.name: Kendrick Lamar & SZA: Grand National Tour - Arlington
games.description: Kendrick Lamar and SZA brought the Grand National Tour to AT&T Stadium in Arlington on April 26, 2025, early in a co-headlining stadium run that followed Lamar's album GNX. The pair traded the stage across six acts rather than splitting the night in two, with Lamar opening on "Wacced Out Murals" and the two joining forces on "All the Stars" before a closing stretch of "Peekaboo" and "DNA."

games.name: Beyonce: Cowboy Carter Tour - Los Angeles (Opening Night)
games.description: Beyonce opened her Cowboy Carter Tour at SoFi Stadium on April 28, 2025, the first of five nights in Inglewood and the most shows any single artist had played at the stadium. The nearly three-hour performance ran close to 40 songs and mixed Cowboy Carter material with Renaissance and older catalogue, and her daughters Blue Ivy and Rumi Carter joined her on stage.

games.name: AC/DC: Power Up Tour - Detroit
games.description: AC/DC returned to Detroit for the first time in nearly a decade on April 30, 2025, filling Ford Field on the North American leg of the Power Up Tour. The Pretty Reckless opened the stadium show. Angus Young and Brian Johnson worked through a career-spanning set that began with "Stiff Upper Lip" and ran through "Thunderstruck," "Back in Black" and "Highway to Hell" before closing on "For Those About to Rock."

games.name: Jack White: No Name Tour - San Francisco
games.description: Jack White played The Masonic in San Francisco on May 17, 2025 as part of the No Name Tour, the theater run supporting his surprise-released album No Name. The show, promoted locally by radio station LIVE 105, drew on the full span of his catalogue, mixing No Name material with songs from The White Stripes and The Raconteurs alongside his solo work. The Masonic date sat within a spring leg that kept White in mid-sized rooms rather than arenas.

games.name: ATEEZ 2025 World Tour [In Your Fantasy] - New York
games.description: ATEEZ played Citi Field on July 13, 2025 as part of their In Your Fantasy world tour, becoming only the second K-pop act to headline the Queens ballpark after BTS. The show started at 8 p.m. and ran close to three hours, built around eight individual solo stages, full-scale group choreography and a setlist drawn from across the group's catalogue.

games.name: Lollapalooza 2025
games.description: The 2025 edition of Lollapalooza ran four days in Chicago's Grant Park with more than 170 acts spread across eight stages. Tyler, the Creator and Luke Combs closed the opening Thursday, Olivia Rodrigo and Korn headlined Friday, Rufus Du Sol and Twice took Saturday, and Sabrina Carpenter and A$AP Rocky finished the weekend. Doechii, Clairo, Gracie Abrams, Djo and Finneas also performed.

games.name: Lil Wayne: Tha Carter VI Tour - Atlantic City
platforms: Jim Whelan Boardwalk Hall, Atlantic City, NJ
games.description: Lil Wayne played Jim Whelan Boardwalk Hall on August 2, 2025 as part of Tha Carter VI Tour, a 34-city North American run supporting the sixth entry in his Carter album series and marking more than twenty years of the franchise. Tyga had been billed as support but withdrew from the date, and French Montana was announced in his place ahead of the Atlantic City show.

games.name: Nine Inch Nails: Peel It Back Tour - Oakland
games.description: Nine Inch Nails opened the North American leg of the Peel It Back Tour at Oakland Arena on August 6, 2025. Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross were joined onstage by Robin Finck, Alessandro Cortini and Ilan Rubin, with Boys Noize supporting. The arena run continued through Portland, Vancouver, Chicago, Toronto, Boston, Brooklyn, Nashville and Houston before wrapping on September 18 at the Kia Forum in Los Angeles.

games.name: Oasis: Live '25 - Edinburgh
games.description: Oasis played the first of three nights at Scottish Gas Murrayfield in Edinburgh on August 8, 2025, part of the Live '25 reunion run. Demand was heavy enough that a third Edinburgh date was added on August 12 alongside the original August 8 and 9 shows. Cast opened at six in the evening and Richard Ashcroft followed at seven, with Liam and Noel Gallagher taking the stage at quarter past eight and a curfew of half past ten.

games.name: Dropkick Murphys & Bad Religion: Summer of Discontent - Cleveland
games.developer: Dropkick Murphys, Bad Religion, The Mainliners
games.description: Dropkick Murphys and Bad Religion brought their co-headlining Summer of Discontent tour to Jacobs Pavilion in Cleveland on August 10, 2025, with The Mainliners opening the bill. Doors and the first set began at seven in the evening, Bad Religion went on at a quarter to eight, and Dropkick Murphys followed at twenty-five past nine. The waterfront amphitheatre show was one of the earlier stops on the two-band summer package.

games.name: Rod Stewart: One Last Time - Nashville
games.description: Rod Stewart brought the One Last Time tour to Ascend Amphitheater in downtown Nashville on August 14, 2025, with Cheap Trick opening the bill. The show began at 7:30pm and drew on five decades of material, closing with Maggie May and Da Ya Think I'm Sexy. Stewart had announced ahead of the run that he intended to step back from large-scale touring.

games.name: System of a Down & Korn - MetLife Stadium
games.developer: System of a Down, Korn, Polyphia, Wisp
games.description: System of a Down closed a two-night stand at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford on August 28, 2025, the second of back-to-back New Jersey stadium dates on their North American run. Korn co-headlined that evening, with Polyphia and Wisp opening from a five-thirty start. The tour paired System with a different co-headliner in each market, and the New Jersey shows included a tribute to Ozzy Osbourne.

games.name: Linkin Park: From Zero World Tour - Denver
games.description: Linkin Park played Ball Arena in Denver on September 3, 2025 on the From Zero World Tour, the band's first major touring cycle in nearly a decade and the first with vocalist Emily Armstrong and drummer Colin Brittain. Jean Dawson opened the Denver show. The set paired From Zero tracks such as The Emptiness Machine, Heavy Is The Crown and Two Faced with older catalogue staples, and the tour ran to more than fifty dates across North America, Asia, Europe and Latin America.

games.name: MARINA: The Princess of Power Tour - Seattle
games.description: MARINA opened The Princess of Power Tour at Showbox SoDo in Seattle on September 6, 2025, the first night of a twenty-one city North American trek behind her sixth studio album. Coco & Clair Clair supported. The show started at half past eight and was all ages. Princess of Power, released in June 2025, had entered the United States dance and electronic albums chart at number two and the United Kingdom albums chart at number seven.

games.name: Pulp: Here Comes More - Forest Hills
games.description: Pulp played Forest Hills Stadium in Queens on September 11, 2025 during the North American leg of their Here Comes More tour, the band's touring return behind the 2025 album More. Jarvis Cocker led a theatrical set that moved between new material and Different Class staples including Babies, with Common People held back for the finale. Reviewers singled out the show's saturated, shifting stage lighting and the band's precision, and the same North American run also took in Red Rocks Amphitheatre.

games.name: Stereolab: North American Tour 2025 - Atlanta
games.description: Stereolab played Variety Playhouse in Atlanta's Little Five Points on September 14, 2025, an eight o'clock start on a southern swing that also took in Nashville, Miami, New Orleans, Athens, Asheville and Saxapahaw. The dates followed the reactivated group's first new studio album in more than fifteen years and leaned on both recent material and their motorik back catalogue.

games.name: Pierce the Veil: I Can't Hear You World Tour - London
games.developer: Pierce the Veil, Cavetown, Hot Mulligan, Crawlers
games.description: Pierce the Veil headlined OVO Arena Wembley on September 23, 2025, the London stop of the I Can't Hear You World Tour and the largest UK headline show of the San Diego band's career. Around 12,000 fans attended a bill that also carried Crawlers, Hot Mulligan and Cavetown across the evening. The headline set ranged across the band's catalogue rather than leaning on any single album era.

games.name: LCD Soundsystem & Pulp - Hollywood Bowl
games.description: LCD Soundsystem and Pulp shared the bill at the Hollywood Bowl on September 26, 2025, the second of two co-headlining nights that were the only confirmed dates to feature the pairing. Pulp were touring their eighth album More, their first record since 2001, while the Bowl shows served as the finale of LCD Soundsystem's 2025 North American run. Reviewers described the double bill as a disco-leaning night that moved between Britpop and dance-punk.

games.name: Ethel Cain: Willoughby Tucker Forever Tour - Manchester
games.description: Ethel Cain opened the UK leg of the Willoughby Tucker Forever tour at the O2 Apollo in Manchester on October 2, 2025, returning to the same room the following night after demand prompted a second date. 9Million supported. The run continued to O2 Academy Glasgow on October 4 and London's Eventim Apollo on October 9, following the album released that summer.

games.name: Austin City Limits Music Festival 2025
games.description: The 2025 Austin City Limits Music Festival filled Zilker Park across two weekends, October 3 to 5 and October 10 to 12. Sabrina Carpenter, Hozier, Luke Combs, The Strokes and Doechii headlined, with The Killers added late to replace Doja Cat, who withdrew in August. Cage the Elephant, Empire of the Sun, T-Pain, Djo, Rilo Kiley and Modest Mouse rounded out the bill.

games.name: Air: Moon Safari Live - Brooklyn
games.description: French duo Air opened a three-night Brooklyn Paramount residency on October 10, 2025, performing their 1998 debut Moon Safari in full. Seated shows on October 10 and 11 were followed by a general-admission finale on October 12, billed as a special club version of the record plus a second set drawn from their wider catalogue, which wrapped the North American tour.

games.name: Lorde: Ultrasound World Tour - Red Rocks
games.developer: Lorde, The Japanese House, Blood Orange
games.description: Lorde made her Red Rocks Amphitheatre debut on October 14, 2025, a Colorado stop on the Ultrasound World Tour behind her album Virgin. The Japanese House and Blood Orange opened the show, which leaned heavily on the new record while working in older singles. Local reviewers singled out the amphitheatre's natural acoustics as a defining part of the night.

games.name: Billie Eilish: Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour - Belmont Park
games.description: Billie Eilish played the first of two nights at UBS Arena in Belmont Park on October 25, 2025 on Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour. Puerto Rican rapper Young Miko opened both evenings, and the pair of shows sold out within hours of going on sale. The tour was staged around a sustainability programme covering reduced greenhouse gas emissions, cuts to single-use plastic and expanded plant-based concessions at each venue.

games.name: Oasis: Live '25 - Sydney
games.description: Oasis played the first of two sold-out Sydney nights at Accor Stadium on November 7, 2025, with a second show following on November 8. The two concerts drew roughly 140,000 people between them, and Ball Park Music opened the Australian leg. The Live '25 reunion run had already passed through Melbourne's Marvel Stadium and ranked among the highest-grossing tours ever staged.

games.name: Radiohead: European Tour 2025 - London
games.description: Radiohead closed a four-night stand at The O2 Arena on November 25, 2025, the final London date of a 20-show European tour that ended a seven-year absence from the stage. The run played to more than 22,200 people a night and the closing show reached 22,355, breaking the arena attendance record Metallica had held since 2017.

games.name: Tame Impala: Deadbeat Tour - Philadelphia
games.description: Tame Impala played Xfinity Mobile Arena on July 15, 2026, the sixth stop of the second North American leg of the Deadbeat Tour. Djo supported the first half of that run, and Kevin Parker's band performed on a stage set in the round with a career-spanning set drawing on Deadbeat alongside Currents and Lonerism material. Tickets for the leg were sold through Ticketmaster's Face Value Exchange to curb resale.

games.name: Charli xcx - Music, Fashion, Film
games.description: Charli xcx releases her seventh studio album, Music, Fashion, Film, on July 24, 2026, via Atlantic Records, produced with longtime collaborators A. G. Cook and Finn Keane. The album was preceded by three singles: lead track 'Rock Music,' followed by 'SS26' and 'Wink Wink.' Its black-and-white cover features John Cale, Marc Jacobs and Martin Scorsese as emblems of the title's three disciplines. Charli supports the release with an eponymous North American arena tour running September and October.

games.name: Morgan Wallen - Been By Now
games.description: Morgan Wallen released the standalone single Been By Now on July 24, 2026, a day after an exclusive first play on his SiriusXM channel. He debuted the song live at M&T Bank Stadium in Baltimore, and it went to United States hot adult contemporary radio on July 27 and to pop and country formats on July 28. Wallen wrote it with Charlie Handsome, John Byron, Blake Pendergrass, Rocky Block and Taylor Phillips, framing a relationship that never moved past the will-they-won't-they stage.

games.name: ENHYPEN: Blood Saga World Tour - Oakland
games.description: ENHYPEN bring their fourth world tour, Blood Saga, to Oakland Arena for two nights on July 28 and 29, 2026, both starting at 7:30 PM with doors at 6:00 PM. The North American leg follows the seven-member group's 2025 WALK THE LINE tour, which sold out its US and European legs, and continues on to Las Vegas after Oakland. ENGENE membership presale ran April 22-23, with general on-sale opening April 24 via Ticketmaster and AXS.

games.name: Lollapalooza 2026
games.description: Lollapalooza returns to Grant Park in Chicago for four days, July 30 to August 2, 2026, with more than 150 acts across seven stages under a 10-year city contract extension. Daily headliners are Lorde and John Summit on Thursday, Charli xcx and The Smashing Pumpkins on Friday, Olivia Dean and Jennie of Blackpink on Saturday, and Tate McRae and The xx on Sunday. The bill also features Turnstile, Aespa, Clipse, YOASOBI and Yungblud. Four-day passes are waitlisted, but single-day tickets remain on sale.

games.name: Djo (with Pond) - Richmond
platforms: Allianz Amphitheater at Riverfront, Richmond, VA
games.description: Djo, the psychedelic pop-rock project of actor and musician Joe Keery, wraps his summer 2026 headline run on July 31 at Allianz Amphitheater in Richmond, Virginia, with Australian band Pond as support. The show closes a short string of headline dates slotted between Keery's summer stint opening for Tame Impala. Tickets went on general sale March 20 through Ticketmaster.

games.name: Lil Uzi Vert - Maverick “Almost Forever” EP
games.description: Lil Uzi Vert surprise-released the eight-track EP Maverick “Almost Forever” on July 31, 2026, their first new music of the year and a birthday drop that landed hours after a scheduled Lollapalooza set in Chicago was scrapped over travel problems. The record carries no guest features and returns to the melodic trap register of their earlier work, including London, a song previewed at Lyrical Lemonade's Summer Smash. The artwork hides the phrase “Album after this.”

games.name: New Radicals - One Night Only (Break Loose Break Free!)
games.description: New Radicals put out One Night Only (Break Loose Break Free!) on July 31, 2026, their first original song in twenty-eight years. Gregg Alexander and Danielle Brisebois wrote the piano-led pop-rock track with Nick Lashley as the theme for the romantic comedy One Night Only, starring Monica Barbaro and Callum Turner and due in cinemas on August 7. The group last released the album Maybe You've Been Brainwashed Too in 1998, home to You Get What You Give.

games.name: Rush: Fifty Something - New York
platforms: Madison Square Garden, New York, NY
games.description: Rush play the third of four Madison Square Garden nights on their Fifty Something tour, with founding members Geddy Lee and Alex Lifeson joined by drummer Anika Nilles. The New York run covers July 28, July 30, August 1 and August 3, 2026. The band's official site lists the date, and tickets are sold through Ticketmaster and the venue.

games.name: Foo Fighters: Take Cover Tour - Detroit
games.description: Foo Fighters open their 2026 Take Cover Tour on August 6 at Ford Field in Detroit, kicking off a stadium run that stretches to September 26 at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas. Queens of the Stone Age serve as direct support across the trek, which stops at NFL stadiums and ballparks including Soldier Field, Lincoln Financial Field and Nissan Stadium. Tickets for the Detroit opener and other dates are on sale through Ticketmaster.

games.name: My Chemical Romance: The Black Parade 2026 - New York
games.description: My Chemical Romance mark the 20th anniversary of their album The Black Parade with an expanded 2026 stadium tour. The North American leg resumes on August 9 at Citi Field in New York and wraps on October 24 with a three-night stand at the Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles. Rotating support across the dates includes Iggy Pop, Babymetal, Pierce the Veil, The Mars Volta, Franz Ferdinand and Jimmy Eat World. Tickets went on general sale September 26, 2025.

games.name: Avenged Sevenfold & Good Charlotte - Belmont Park, NY
games.description: Avenged Sevenfold and Good Charlotte co-headline a 16-date North American summer run, stopping at UBS Arena in Belmont Park, New York on August 10, 2026. The tour opened July 25 in Ridgedale, Missouri and closes August 27 in Phoenix, pairing the Orange County metal band with the pop-punk veterans. Tickets went on general sale December 12, 2025 through the two acts' official websites, following a Deathbats Club and early-access presale.

games.name: MAMAMOO 2026 US Reunion Tour - Belmont Park
games.description: All four members of MAMAMOO - Solar, Moonbyul, Whee In and Hwasa - reunite for a seven-arena American run that opens August 12 at UBS Arena in Belmont Park, New York. The tour then visits Chicago, Fort Worth, Cedar Park, Los Angeles and San Jose before closing August 30 at the accesso ShoWare Center in Kent, Washington. It is the group's first US touring since the 2023 My Con world tour.

games.name: Peace Test - Repercussion
games.description: Rhode Island hardcore punk band Peace Test release their album Repercussion on August 14, 2026 through Delayed Gratification Records. It is their first full-length since Pry in 2022, and the lead single Total Power arrived ahead of the announcement. Cedrick Gustave created the cover artwork. The record is being issued on both digital platforms and physical formats through the label.

games.name: Ariana Grande: The Eternal Sunshine Tour - London (The O2 Residency)
games.description: Ariana Grande caps her 2026 Eternal Sunshine Tour with a European-exclusive residency at The O2 in London. The run spans 10 nights between August 15 and September 1, 2026, the longest single-venue stretch of her career and her first UK performances since 2019. The shows support her album Eternal Sunshine and its deluxe follow-up, Brighter Days Ahead. All 10 London dates sold out, leaving resale as the only remaining option.

games.name: BTS World Tour 'ARIRANG' - Arlington
games.description: BTS return to the road with their 'ARIRANG' world tour, the group's first outing with all seven members since their military service. The Arlington run brings two stadium shows to AT&T Stadium on August 15 and 16, 2026, both starting at 8:00 PM. These Texas dates are part of a sprawling 2026-2027 tour of roughly 79 shows across 34 regions. Both nights sold out during the initial January on-sale, so seats are now only available through resale.

games.name: Brandon Flowers - Thrasher
games.description: The Killers frontman Brandon Flowers releases Thrasher, his third solo album and first in over a decade, on August 21, 2026 via Island Records. Recorded in Nashville at Historic RCA Studio A with producers Shawn Everett and Jonathan Rado, the record leans toward country and features guitarist David Rawlings, pedal-steel player Bruce Bouton and 85-year-old harmonica veteran Charlie McCoy. It follows 2010's Flamingo and 2015's The Desired Effect.

games.name: Um, Jennifer? - Dirty Twice (EP)
games.description: Brooklyn post-punk duo Um, Jennifer? release the EP Dirty Twice on August 21, 2026 via Final Girl. Fig and Eli wrote and recorded the whole thing themselves, splitting vocals, guitar, bass and drums between them, with Teddy O'Mara producing. The lead single Bushwick Ratbag introduced the record, and the jangly Comedy 42, first shared in February, also appears on the track list. The duo tour behind it this autumn supporting Slothrust.

games.name: Bon Jovi: Forever Tour - UK & Ireland
games.description: Bon Jovi cross the Atlantic for a short stadium run after their July residency at Madison Square Garden, opening August 28 at Scottish Gas Murrayfield in Edinburgh and playing Croke Park in Dublin on August 30. The leg closes with three nights at Wembley Stadium in London on September 4, 6 and 9. These are the band's first extensive shows since Jon Bon Jovi underwent vocal cord surgery.

games.name: Jim James - Wowed Out
games.description: Jim James releases Wowed Out, his new solo album, on August 28, 2026. The My Morning Jacket frontman shared the title track alongside the announcement and described the record as drawing on Alice Coltrane's spiritual recordings, saying he wanted the songs to feel like a journey that takes the listener somewhere rewarding. A solo acoustic tour follows from November 28, 2026 through April 25, 2027.

games.name: Fcukers: Fall 2026 North American Tour
platforms: Acrisure Amphitheater, Grand Rapids, MI (North American leg opener)
games.description: New York dance-punk trio Fcukers, named Spotify's Radar US Artist of 2026 after their acclaimed debut album 'O', return for a North American headlining run following their Together Together support dates with Harry Styles. The leg opens September 1 in Grand Rapids and reaches Toronto, Atlanta's Shaky Knees, San Francisco's Portola and both Austin City Limits weekends through October 11. Support comes from Baby Wave, SEES00000 and Total Wife on select dates. Presales start July 28, general sale July 29.

games.name: Silvana Estrada: Vendran Suaves Lluvias Tour - North America
games.description: Mexican singer-songwriter and Latin Grammy winner Silvana Estrada brings her Vendran Suaves Lluvias tour to North America in 2026. After select US festival appearances and Mon Laferte support dates in August, her headlining run opens September 3 in Portland, Oregon, crosses into Canada at Vancouver's Chan Centre for the Performing Arts on September 6, and continues through Los Angeles, Miami, Nashville and other cities. Presales began July 22 in select cities, with general on-sale opening July 24.

games.name: ADÉLA - PRIMA
games.description: ADÉLA, the Bratislava-born pop provocateur, announced her debut album 'PRIMA' for release on September 4, 2026 via Capitol Records, executive-produced by Dylan Brady and Blake Slatkin. The reveal on July 23 arrived alongside the single and music video 'Ain't In LA,' filmed in her hometown, and follows earlier teasers 'KGB' and 'Red Bottoms.' Across the record she digs into insecurity, toxic relationships, and themes of love, loss, identity, and friendship.

games.name: Garth Brooks: Blame It All On My Roots Tour - Denver
games.description: Country superstar Garth Brooks brings his retro-styled Blame It All On My Roots arena tour to Denver for back-to-back nights at Ball Arena on September 4 and 5, his first Colorado shows in seven years. Following the tour's opening city of Indianapolis, all seats are a single flat price of $155.25 including fees. There are no presales or advance sales; every ticket goes on sale at the same time on July 31 at 10 a.m. Mountain, with an eight-ticket limit.

games.name: Kasabian - ACT III
games.description: Leicester rock band Kasabian release their ninth studio album, ACT III, on September 4, 2026. The record was pushed back from its original July 17 date after the band chose to make final adjustments, saying they couldn't send it out 'without getting everything just right.' It follows 2024's Happenings, with Serge Pizzorno again handling lead vocals since Tom Meighan's 2020 departure.

games.name: Lupe Fiasco & Gym Class Heroes: Back To Basics Tour - Cleveland
games.developer: Lupe Fiasco, Gym Class Heroes, B.o.B
games.description: Hip-hop veterans Lupe Fiasco and Gym Class Heroes co-headline the 19-date Back To Basics Tour, with B.o.B along as special guest on most stops. The fall trek opens September 10, 2026 at Cleveland's Jacobs Pavilion and runs through late October, hitting Pittsburgh, Denver, Minneapolis, Detroit, San Antonio and Boston among other cities. Tickets went on general sale July 17 via Ticketmaster and Live Nation.

games.name: BIGBANG 2026 World Tour - East Rutherford
games.description: BIGBANG bring their 20th anniversary stadium tour to MetLife Stadium on September 11, one of only two North American stops on a 31-show run that opened August 21 at Goyang Stadium in South Korea. G-DRAGON, TAEYANG and DAESUNG reunited for the trek, their first since 2017, which also visits Oakland Coliseum on September 5 before continuing through Europe and Australia into February 2027.

games.name: Charli xcx: Music, Fashion, Film Tour - Philadelphia
games.description: Charli xcx opens her Music, Fashion, Film Tour at Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia on September 11, 2026, at 8:00 PM, in support of her seventh studio album of the same name. The arena run continues across North America into late October, including two-night stands in Brooklyn and Los Angeles, with underscores as support on every date. An artist presale ran June 12 at 9:00 AM, followed by general on-sale the same day at 1:00 PM through Ticketmaster, including $20 'Angel Tickets.'

games.name: Chrome Sparks: Ball Of Light
games.description: Producer Jeremy Malvin issues Ball Of Light, his first full-length as Chrome Sparks since the 2018 self-titled debut, on September 11 via Chrome Sounds and AWAL. The twelve-track record is led by the single Sleeper, which pairs Khalid's vocal with Jonsi of Sigur Ros over cinematic electronic production. Malvin has described the album as the sound of finding himself again after years away.

games.name: Phoebe Bridgers: The Lost Tour - Indianapolis
games.description: Phoebe Bridgers brings The Lost Tour to Indianapolis for two nights, September 14 and 15, 2026, at Gainbridge Fieldhouse, with both shows starting at 7:30 PM. The completely phone-free arena tour supports her third studio album, Lost Weekend, and runs through North America before continuing to the UK and Europe in November. Alex G opens the North American dates, and all phones and smartwatches are secured in Yondr pouches for the duration of each show. Tickets went on sale June 12 at 10:00 AM ET.

games.name: Ministry: Hate To Go Farewell Tour - Red Rocks
games.description: After 45 years, founder Al Jourgensen is retiring his industrial metal institution Ministry, a farewell tied to the band's final studio album 'Hate To Go (Take Out or Delivery),' due October 30. The 2026 U.S. dates open at Red Rocks Amphitheatre in Morrison, Colorado on September 15, followed by festival appearances at Louder Than Life and Sick New World Texas and a Chicago headline show at the Salt Shed on October 3. A Goodbye Europe leg is set for spring 2027.

games.name: Jon Pardi: Gamblin' Man Tour - Richmond
platforms: Allianz Amphitheater at Riverfront, Richmond, VA
games.description: Country hitmaker Jon Pardi launches his 19-date Gamblin' Man Tour, named after a track from his 2025 album Honkytonk Hollywood, at Richmond's Allianz Amphitheater at Riverfront on September 17, 2026. The neo-traditional run visits arenas and amphitheaters across the South, Midwest and West before wrapping November 14 in Independence, Missouri. Alexandra Kay and Sadie Bass open on the tour.

games.name: GAYLE - Observing Chaos
games.description: Pop singer-songwriter GAYLE, known for the viral 2021 breakout hit 'abcdefu', releases her debut studio album 'Observing Chaos' on September 18, 2026 via Atlantic Records. The record spans thirteen tracks and is led by the singles 'Loving You Is' and the summery 'junebug!', marking the start of a new era after her earlier EPs. GAYLE has teased a fan album-listening roadtrip ahead of the release.

games.name: Orville Peck - Mule
games.description: Orville Peck releases Mule, his fourth studio album, on September 18, 2026 through Warner Records. The 13-track record traces the year that reshaped his life, moving through addiction, the pursuit of sobriety and the slow work of rebuilding. Lead single Too Little, Too Late arrived with the announcement, written with Dan Wilson and Steve Rusch and produced by Jay Joyce. The album also features Prologue (Eulogy Of A Man Turned Mule), a collaboration with Emmylou Harris, Noah Cyrus and Allison Russell.

games.name: Riot Fest 2026
games.developer: Tool, Twenty One Pilots, Alanis Morissette, Pierce the Veil, Iggy Pop, Morrissey
games.description: Riot Fest returns to Douglass Park in Chicago's North Lawndale neighborhood for three days from September 18 to 20, 2026, with more than one hundred artists booked across its stages. Twenty One Pilots and Iggy Pop lead the Friday bill, Tool and Morrissey headline Saturday, and Pierce The Veil and Alanis Morissette close the festival on Sunday. That final day also brings the live debut of The *uckers, the heavy metal band fronted by ninety-five-year-old William Shatner.

games.name: Rebecca Black: Exhibitionism on Tour - Boston
games.description: Rebecca Black launches Exhibitionism on Tour, a 27-date North American headlining run supporting her sophomore album Age of the Exhibitionist, due September 4, 2026. The trek opens September 23 at the Royale in Boston and works through clubs, theaters and ballrooms in Atlanta, Nashville, Dallas, Toronto, Chicago and Denver before the headline portion closes November 5 at the Fonda Theatre in Los Angeles. An artist and fan-club presale began July 22, with general on-sale July 24 via Ticketmaster.

games.name: Lucinda Williams: World's Gone Wrong Tour - Atlanta
games.description: Roots and Americana icon Lucinda Williams announces World's Gone Wrong, an extensive 31-date North American headlining tour behind her new album of the same name. The fall run opens with two nights at Variety Playhouse in Atlanta on September 24 and 25, then moves through the Carolinas, Washington D.C. and a sweep of the Northeast. An artist presale ran July 15 to 17, with tickets going on general sale July 17 via Ticketmaster.

games.name: Slothrust: The Dystopian Theatre Tour - Boston
games.description: Slothrust stop at Royale in Boston on September 24 during The Dystopian Theatre Tour, the alt-rock trio's first headline run in more than a year and their first since signing to Equal Vision Records. The Velveteers support the eastern dates, with Um, Jennifer? joining the western leg. The tour opened September 15 in Omaha and finishes November 18 at The Bellwether in Los Angeles.

games.name: Icona Pop: Ritual Fall Tour - Brooklyn
games.description: Swedish synthpop duo Icona Pop open a short American club run at Baby's All Right in Brooklyn on September 25, 2026, supporting their album Ritual, out August 14 via Ultra Records and Iconic Sound Recordings. Caroline Hjelt and Aino Jawo follow the Brooklyn date with Lincoln Hall in Chicago on October 2, a Las Vegas show on November 20 and the Moroccan Lounge in Los Angeles on November 21. Tickets are on general sale through the band's site.

games.name: Ocean Way Festival 2026
platforms: Santa Monica Beach, Santa Monica, CA
games.developer: The Killers, Jack White, Olivia Dean, Khruangbin, Sublime
games.description: Goldenvoice, the promoter behind Coachella and Stagecoach, launches Ocean Way Festival on the sand at Santa Monica Beach across September 26 and 27, 2026. The Killers, Jack White and Olivia Dean headline an inaugural bill that also features Khruangbin, Sublime, Alvvays, Durand Jones & The Indications, Hiatus Kaiyote, SG Lewis, BLOND:ISH, Poolside and a Hot Chip DJ set. Single-day and two-day general admission passes went on sale in July.

games.name: Michelle Branch: Everywhere and Back Again Tour - Seattle
games.description: Michelle Branch returns to the road with the Everywhere and Back Again Tour, an 18-date US headlining run supporting a forthcoming EP of newly recorded versions of career-spanning songs, due November 6, 2026 via BMG. The tour opens September 27 at The Showbox in Seattle and runs through November 13 at Manchester Music Hall in Lexington, Kentucky. Tickets went on sale in July, and several shows sold out rapidly after the announcement.

games.name: Audrey Hobert: The Staircase To Stardom Tour - Fall 2026
games.description: Audrey Hobert extends The Staircase To Stardom Tour into autumn with the biggest headline rooms of her career, opening the final leg at Brooklyn Paramount on September 29, 2026. The run announced in late July continues through Nashville's Ryman Auditorium, two nights at Chicago's Riviera Theatre and Oakland's Fox Theater, and is built around her debut album Who's The Clown?. She also plays both weekends of Austin City Limits in October.

games.name: Ringo Starr & His All Starr Band - Forest Hills, NY
games.developer: Ringo Starr & His All Starr Band
games.description: Ringo Starr and His All Starr Band bring their fall 2026 North American run to Forest Hills Stadium in Queens, New York on October 1, 2026. The ten-date trek opens September 24 in Easton, Pennsylvania and wraps October 7 in Albany. The 2026 lineup features Steve Lukather, Colin Hay, Warren Ham, Hamish Stuart, Gregg Bissonette and Buck Johnson. General tickets went on sale July 10, 2026 at 10 a.m. local time through Ticketmaster.

games.name: Austin City Limits Music Festival 2026
games.description: Austin City Limits returns for its 25th anniversary across two weekends, October 2-4 and October 9-11, 2026, at Zilker Park in Austin. The lineup is headlined by Charli XCX, Rufus Du Sol, Twenty One Pilots, Lorde and The XX, with Skrillex topping Weekend 1 and Kings of Leon topping Weekend 2. Other acts include Turnstile, Labrinth, The Chainsmokers, Young Miko and Bleachers. Three-day passes and premium packages are on sale now.

games.name: Victoria Monét - Frequency of Love
games.description: Grammy-winning R&B singer-songwriter Victoria Monét releases her sophomore studio album Frequency of Love on October 2, 2026 via Lovett Music and RCA Records. The 22-track project follows her breakthrough Jaguar II and is led by the KAYTRANADA- and D'Mile-produced single Reach Out, with Camper serving as executive producer. It marks Monét's first full-length since her 2024 Best New Artist Grammy win.

games.name: Monsta X: THE X : NEXUS World Tour - New York
platforms: Madison Square Garden(Infosys Theater), New York, NY
games.description: Monsta X bring THE X : NEXUS, their 2026 world tour, to the Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden on October 6, with doors at 7:00 PM and the show starting at 8:00 PM. The North American leg runs October 3-24 across ten cities including Fairfax, Boston, Toronto and Los Angeles, following the tour's launch with three sold-out nights at Seoul's KSPO Dome and stops across Asia and Latin America. Tickets have been on sale since April 14 through Ticketmaster.

games.name: Trombone Shorty & Orleans Avenue: Fall 2026 Tour
games.description: Grammy-winning New Orleans bandleader Trombone Shorty and Orleans Avenue add a run of fall 2026 dates, opening October 8 in Chattanooga and moving through North Carolina, Virginia and a stretch of Northeast shows from October 16 to 24. The October 23 date at Newark's NJPAC features Mavis Staples, while singer-songwriter Abraham Alexander joins as special guest on select nights. An artist presale started July 22, with general on-sale July 24.

games.name: ZZ Top: The Big One! Tour - Nashville
games.description: Texas blues-rock legends ZZ Top continue The Big One! Tour through fall 2026, with several North American dates co-headlined by fellow Rock and Roll Hall of Famers Cheap Trick. The band's Nashville stop was moved from September 26 to October 8 at Ascend Amphitheater, freeing guitarist Billy Gibbons to appear at Eric Clapton's Crossroads Guitar Festival in Austin. The trek later extends to Mexico and South America in November.

games.name: Amon Amarth: The Allfather Awakens Tour - Manchester
platforms: O2 Apollo, Manchester, England (UK/EU leg opener)
games.description: Swedish melodic death metal veterans Amon Amarth headline The Allfather Awakens tour across the UK and mainland Europe, opening October 9, 2026 at Manchester's O2 Apollo and finishing November 15 in Lisbon over roughly 28 dates. The run features an updated stage production and an extended headlining set, with support from Orbit Culture and Soilwork. It accompanies the band's thirteenth studio album, 'The Allfather Awakens', due on Metal Blade Records in the second half of 2026.

games.name: Godsmack: The Rise of Rock World Tour - Airway Heights
platforms: Northern Quest Resort & Casino, Airway Heights, WA
games.description: Godsmack extend their Rise of Rock world tour with a ten-date October run through the American Midwest and Northeast, opening at Northern Quest Resort & Casino in Airway Heights, Washington. Dorothy joins as direct support across the leg, which wraps on October 24 at Mohegan Sun Arena in Uncasville. Presales ran July 29 to 31, with general tickets going on sale July 31 at 10 a.m. local time.

games.name: Greta Van Fleet: Palace For The People
games.description: Greta Van Fleet release their fourth studio album, Palace For The People, on October 9 through Republic Records. The Michigan band recorded it in Tennessee during spring 2026 and co-produced the sessions with Mike Elizondo, whose credits include Turnstile and Fiona Apple. Lead single Saw You Stand arrived July 31, following the earlier comeback track Play Your Games after an extended break from the road.

games.name: Ryan Bingham & The Texas Gentlemen: Still Gettin' Away With It Tour (Fall Theater Leg)
platforms: Satellite Music Hall, Memphis, TN (fall leg opener)
games.description: Academy Award and Grammy-winning songwriter Ryan Bingham extends his Still Gettin' Away With It Tour with a fall theater leg backed by The Texas Gentlemen. The run opens October 13 in Memphis and travels through Nashville's Ryman Auditorium, Chicago's Riviera Theatre and St. Louis' The Pageant before a string of Texas dates, wrapping November 14 at Billy Bob's in Fort Worth. Presales began July 22, with general on-sale opening July 24.

games.name: Tyla: A*POP World Tour - London
games.description: Tyla brings her A*POP World Tour to O2 Academy Brixton on October 15, 2026, one of 34 dates announced on July 27. The run supports APOP, the Grammy winner's second album, released July 24. The tour opens October 12 at Zenith Paris and works through Amsterdam, Glasgow, Manchester, Brussels, Berlin and Stockholm before a North American leg starting November 12 in Wheatland, California, and closing dates in Lagos, Cape Town and Johannesburg. An artist presale runs July 29 via Laylo, with general on-sale July 31 through Ticketmaster.

games.name: Rachel Chinouriri - I think I spoke too soon
games.description: British alt-pop singer-songwriter Rachel Chinouriri releases her second album, I think I spoke too soon, on October 16, 2026 through Parlophone and Atlas Artists. The record follows her 2024 debut What A Devastating Turn of Events and was written and recorded across London, Hereford and Los Angeles with returning collaborators APOB, Mary Weitz, Glen Roberts and Daniel Hylton-Nuamah alongside newcomers Lucy Dacus and Eli Teplin. Lead single One song away from crying, a synth-leaning pop track, arrived with the announcement on July 30.

games.name: The National and Friends - AB100, San Sebastian
games.description: The National close the AB100 weekend at Kursaal Donostia in San Sebastian on October 18, 2026, playing an expanded "and friends" set that stands as their only confirmed concert of the year and their first live performance since the end of 2024. AB100 is a two-day gathering curated by band members Aaron and Bryce Dessner, running October 17 and 18 in the Basque Country, with Kevin Morby, Ben Howard, Jon Hopkins and Richard Reed Parry among the collaborators taking part. A limited members presale opened July 30 and general tickets go on sale August 3.

games.name: JAY-Z 30th Anniversary - Los Angeles
games.description: JAY-Z plays SoFi Stadium on October 23 and 24, 2026 as part of the 30th anniversary run marking three decades since Reasonable Doubt. The Los Angeles dates were announced July 27 alongside stadium shows at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium in London on September 4 and 5 and Stade de France in Paris on September 10, and they follow three hometown nights at Yankee Stadium earlier in July. Presales open July 29 at 10 a.m. local time with Citi cardholder access in Los Angeles, ahead of the general on-sale July 30 via Ticketmaster.

games.name: Tony Iommi - From the Dark
games.description: Black Sabbath guitarist Tony Iommi releases From the Dark on October 23 via BMG, his first solo album in 21 years and his first full-length record since Black Sabbath's 13 in 2013. The eight-track set was produced with longtime collaborator Mike Exeter and features vocalist Jorn Lande, drummer Karl Brazil and bassist Becky Baldwin. Lead single World Alone arrived alongside the announcement.

games.name: Jodeci: Forever My Lady 35th Anniversary Tour - San Francisco
games.description: R&B group Jodeci mark the 35th anniversary of their debut album Forever My Lady with a 36-date US tour that opens at The Masonic in San Francisco. The route travels through Inglewood, Phoenix, St. Louis, Detroit, Chicago, Houston and New Orleans before closing on December 19 in the group's hometown of Charlotte. An artist presale began July 29, with general tickets on sale July 31 at 10 a.m. local time.

games.name: Tame Impala: Deadbeat Tour - Australia
games.description: Kevin Parker brings the Deadbeat Tour home to Australia in October 2026, closing the year-long run behind Tame Impala's fifth album with two nights at Perth's RAC Arena on October 24 and 25. The Frontier Touring arena run also takes in Brisbane, four nights at Melbourne's Rod Laver Arena and three in Sydney, with Ninajirachi supporting every date and the band performing as a six-piece on a stage set in the round.

games.name: Orville Peck: Man Turned Mule Tour - Sacramento
games.description: Orville Peck opens the Man Turned Mule Tour at Channel 24 in Sacramento on October 28, 2026, launching a 19-date North American theater run behind his fourth album Mule. The itinerary moves through Anaheim, Phoenix, Denver, Minneapolis, Chicago, Philadelphia, Atlanta and Nashville, includes two nights at Brooklyn Paramount on November 9 and 10, and closes November 22 at The Paramount in Huntington, New York. Artist and Citi presales ran from July 28, with the general on-sale on July 31 at 10 a.m. local time.

games.name: THAO - Show Me
games.description: THAO returns to Kill Rock Stars with Show Me on October 30, 2026, her first new album in six years. The record was co-produced by THAO with Merrill Garbus and Nate Brenner of Tune-Yards and features guest turns from Neko Case, The Linda Lindas and Black Pumas guitarist Adrian Quesada. Lead single Sick Of The Times, credited with Tune-Yards and The Linda Lindas, introduced the album in late July, and a short West Coast and East Coast headline run follows in November.

games.name: The Faint: Fall 2026 US Tour - Springfield
games.description: Omaha dance-punk band The Faint return for a 13-date US club tour across October and November, launching at The Regency Live in Springfield, Missouri. The route swings through Indianapolis, Louisville, Memphis, Athens and Miami before finishing on November 15 at The Social in Orlando. An artist presale opened July 29 through the band's own site, and general tickets go on sale July 31 at 10 a.m. local time.

games.name: Quadeca: The Life 1 Tour - Seattle
games.description: Quadeca brings The Life 1 Tour to The Showbox in Seattle on November 6, 2026, one of 23 North American dates supporting his fifth album Life 1. The run opens October 10 at The Nile Theater in Mesa, Arizona and finishes November 10 at The Fonda in his native Los Angeles, with Derby and Oleka opening throughout. An artist presale ran July 29 and general tickets went on sale July 31 at 10 a.m. local time via Ticketmaster; a portion of tour proceeds goes to cancer research nonprofit City of Hope.

games.name: Jimmy Eat World & The Format: Bleed American 25 / Dog Problems 20 - Hollywood Bowl
games.description: Arizona bands Jimmy Eat World and The Format co-headline the Hollywood Bowl on November 7, 2026, marking the first time the two acts have shared a stage. Jimmy Eat World perform Bleed American in full for the album's twenty-fifth anniversary, covering Sweetness, The Middle and Hear You Me, while The Format play their 2006 record Dog Problems front to back for its twentieth. It is one of only two full-album shows The Format have scheduled this year.

games.name: Silverstein & Story of the Year: Camp Screamo 2 - Seattle
games.description: Silverstein and Story of the Year open Camp Screamo 2 at Showbox SoDo in Seattle on November 16, 2026. The co-headlining run covers 24 North American dates through December 13 at Citizens House of Blues in Boston, following the pair's first Camp Screamo leg earlier in the year. Stand Atlantic and Footballhead support throughout. Presales began July 28 with the code CAMPSCREAMO via Ticketmaster, and the general on-sale is July 31 at 10 a.m. local time.

games.name: EsDeeKid: Council House Rat Tour - London
games.description: Liverpool rapper EsDeeKid brings his 48-date Council House Rat Tour to OVO Arena Wembley on December 3, the largest headline show of his career so far. The trek opens with 28 North American dates from September before crossing to Europe in November, with further UK and Ireland stops in Dublin, Glasgow and two homecoming nights in Liverpool. Tickets go on general sale July 31 at 10 a.m.

games.name: Yo La Tengo: Hanukkah 2026
games.description: Yo La Tengo return to the Bowery Ballroom for eight consecutive nights of their long-running Hanukkah benefit residency, opening December 4 and closing December 11, 2026. Each evening pairs a surprise comedian and a surprise musical guest with a Yo La Tengo set that repeats no song across the run, usually ending in an all-covers encore. Proceeds go to charity, and tickets went on sale July 24.

games.name: Goose: Goosemas 2026 - Atlantic City
platforms: Jim Whelan Boardwalk Hall, Atlantic City, NJ
games.description: The Connecticut jam band Goose bring their 13th annual Goosemas celebration to Atlantic City for the first time, playing two nights at the historic Jim Whelan Boardwalk Hall on December 11 and 12, 2026. General tickets went on sale July 24, following VIP, travel package, and local presales. One dollar from every ticket sold benefits the Western Sun Foundation, which supports grassroots nonprofits in the cities the band tours.

games.name: John Mulaney Takes Manhattan - Madison Square Garden Finale
platforms: Madison Square Garden, New York, NY
Radio City Music Hall, New York, NY
games.description: John Mulaney closes his Mulaney Takes Manhattan run at Madison Square Garden on January 15, 2027, the ninth night of a nine-night residency staged at nine different New York City rooms. The sequence starts January 7 at the Comedy Cellar and works upward in scale through the Blue Note, Joe's Pub, Bowery Ballroom, the Music Box Theatre, the Beacon Theatre, Carnegie Hall and Radio City Music Hall. The dates extend his Mister Whatever world tour, which runs across North America through December 2026.

games.name: System of a Down & Faith No More - Australia & New Zealand 2027
games.developer: System of a Down, Faith No More
games.description: System of a Down and Faith No More play four stadium shows across Australia and New Zealand in early 2027, opening January 22 at Accor Stadium in Sydney before Marvel Stadium in Melbourne on January 27, Suncorp Stadium in Brisbane on February 1 and Hnry Stadium in Wellington on February 7. The run marks Faith No More's first concerts in nearly a decade and System of a Down's first Australian dates since 2012. An artist mailing-list presale opened July 28 and general tickets went on sale July 31 with staggered start times in each market.

games.name: Ride: Here And Now 2027 Tour - London
games.description: Oxford shoegaze band Ride play O2 Academy Brixton on February 13, 2027 as part of the six-date Here And Now UK tour, their first live shows in three years. Andy Bell, Mark Gardener, Steve Queralt and Laurence Colbert reunite for a set built around the band's classic material, returning to the venue 34 years after the 1992 concert filmed as Ride - Live at Brixton Academy. The tour opens February 12 in Bournemouth and closes February 19 in Glasgow; general tickets went on sale July 31 at 10am.

games.name: Bryan Adams: Roll With The Punches Tour - Australia & New Zealand
games.description: Canadian rock icon Bryan Adams brings his Roll With The Punches Tour to Australia and New Zealand in early 2027, opening February 23 at Perth's RAC Arena and closing March 12 at Christchurch's Wolfbrook Arena. The arena run, produced by Frontier Touring, supports his sixteenth studio album released in 2025 and features Natalie Imbruglia as special guest. A sold-out Melbourne date at Rod Laver Arena prompted a second show to be added.

games.name: Thomas Rhett: Soundtrack To Life UK Tour - London
games.description: Thomas Rhett returns to the United Kingdom for his first headline arena run there in almost a decade, playing London's The O2 on April 23, 2027. The three-date Soundtrack To Life UK trek opens April 22 at Manchester's AO Arena and closes April 25 at the OVO Hydro in Glasgow, with fellow country singer Kameron Marlowe supporting throughout. A Live Nation sign-up presale opens August 4, 2026 ahead of the general on-sale on August 7.

games.name: Wynonna Judd: The Hard Truth Tour - New York
games.description: Wynonna Judd opens The Hard Truth Tour at New York's Bowery Ballroom on October 8, 2026, launching a fifteen-date headlining run that closes November 21 at Hard Rock Live Northern Indiana in Gary. The theatre-scale trek supports The Hard Truth, her first solo album since 2016, due October 2 on ANTI- Records. Nashville duo Troubadour Blue open every announced date.

games.name: Wynonna Judd - The Hard Truth
games.description: Wynonna Judd releases The Hard Truth on October 2, 2026 through ANTI- Records, her first solo studio album since 2016's Wynonna & the Big Noise. It is also the first record she has co-written throughout, with contributions from Patterson Hood of Drive-By Truckers, The War and Treaty and Iron & Wine. Vinyl pre-orders are open, and a fifteen-date headlining tour follows in October and November.

games.name: ScHoolboy Q: 10 Years of Blank Face LP Tour - Atlanta
games.description: ScHoolboy Q begins the 10 Years of Blank Face LP Tour at the Tabernacle in Atlanta on October 1, 2026. The ten-city run marks the tenth anniversary of his fourth studio album, which reached number two on the Billboard 200 and earned a Best Rap Album Grammy nomination. Stops include Brooklyn Paramount, Washington DC, two Los Angeles nights and a Las Vegas finale on October 17.

games.name: Megadeth: Breakout - Hibernation Of The Nations - London
games.description: Megadeth play OVO Arena Wembley on March 11, 2027 as part of Breakout: Hibernation Of The Nations, the European chapter of the band's multi-year farewell tour. The twenty-four-date arena run opens March 9 at The O2 Belfast and ends April 13 in Lisbon. Black Label Society and Testament support throughout. These are Megadeth's first British headline dates in eleven years.

games.name: Kylie Cantrall: The Valley Girl Problems Tour - Minneapolis
games.description: Kylie Cantrall opens her first headlining tour at The Fillmore Minneapolis on September 25, 2026, with doors for a seven o'clock start. The fifteen-city North American run travels through Chicago, Toronto, Boston, New York, Nashville, Atlanta, Dallas and Houston before a hometown finale at The Novo in Los Angeles on October 22. It supports her Republic Records debut EP Valley Girl Problems.

games.name: Eagles at Sphere - 2027 Dates
games.description: The Eagles extend their Las Vegas residency into 2027 with four additional Sphere performances on January 15, 16, 22 and 23. The run began in September 2024 and now stands at seventy-two shows, the longest of any act at the venue. Tickets start at 175 dollars including taxes and fees. The band opened 2026 by becoming the first act certified quadruple Diamond by the RIAA.

games.name: Bryan Adams: Bare Bones - Wynn Las Vegas
platforms: Encore Theater at Wynn Las Vegas, Las Vegas, NV
games.description: Bryan Adams returns to the Encore Theater at Wynn Las Vegas for a five-night Bare Bones engagement running October 28 through November 1, 2026, including a Halloween performance. The stripped-back show pairs Adams with longtime collaborator and pianist Gary Breit, revisiting his catalogue without a full band. The residency follows two previous sold-out runs at the same room.

games.name: The Band CAMINO Opens Satellite Music Hall - Memphis
games.description: Memphis pop-rock trio The Band CAMINO christen Satellite Music Hall with back-to-back hometown shows on September 4 and 5, 2026. The 1,300-capacity room at Crosstown Concourse is a Live Nation partnership and Memphis's newest dedicated concert venue, programmed for at least one hundred shows a year. The opening slate also features Valerie June, Project Pat, Modest Mouse, Iron & Wine and Prof.

games.name: Riot Fest 2025
games.developer: Blink-182, Weezer, Green Day, Jack White, Sex Pistols, Rilo Kiley
games.description: The twentieth edition of Riot Fest ran September 19 to 21, 2025 in Chicago's Douglass Park. Blink-182 closed Friday, Weezer and Jack White split Saturday headlining duties, and Green Day finished the weekend on Sunday. The bill also included the reunited Rilo Kiley, the Sex Pistols fronted by Frank Carter, Weird Al Yankovic, Jawbreaker, the Beach Boys, Idles, Knocked Loose and Dropkick Murphys.

games.name: Lorde: Virgin Midnight Pop-Up - Brooklyn
games.description: Lorde staged a surprise midnight pop-up at Baby's All Right in Brooklyn on June 23, 2025, days before releasing her fourth album Virgin. She played the record in full for a small crowd and livestreamed the whole event on TikTok for fans who could not fit inside. The Williamsburg venue is name-checked in her single What Was That. She announced it hours earlier by text message.

games.name: Queensryche - Airway Heights
platforms: Northern Quest Resort & Casino(Pend Oreille Pavilion), Airway Heights, WA
games.description: Queensryche played the Pend Oreille Pavilion at Northern Quest Resort & Casino in Airway Heights, Washington on April 10, 2025, with a half past seven start. The 1,200-seat indoor room, which opened in 2004, sits just west of Spokane. Tickets were sold through AXS starting around sixty-one dollars. The Seattle-formed progressive metal band were touring behind their sixteenth studio album.

games.name: Lionel Richie: Acrisure Amphitheater Grand Opening - Grand Rapids
games.developer: Lionel Richie, The War and Treaty, Brian Vander Ark
games.description: Lionel Richie headlined the grand opening of Acrisure Amphitheater in downtown Grand Rapids on May 15, 2026, the first concert at the 12,000-capacity riverfront venue built for 184 million dollars. The War and Treaty and Michigan songwriter Brian Vander Ark opened the night. A free community celebration with food trucks and a drone show followed on May 16.

games.name: Djo: Another Bite Tour - Sacramento
games.description: Djo, the project of actor and musician Joe Keery, played Channel 24 in Sacramento on October 17, 2025 with an eight o'clock start. The date belonged to the Another Bite Tour, an autumn extension of touring behind his third album The Crux, released that April. Chicago band Post Animal opened the North American dates, and the set drew on The Crux, DECIDE and his D-Sides collection.
